column1: How do I reset my password?
column2: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email.

column1: How can I register for a course?
column2: Log in to your student portal, open Course Registration, select your courses, and submit.

column1: How do I pay my tuition fees?
column2: Open the payments section of the student portal and follow the available payment instructions.

column1: What should I do if I forget my username?
column2: Contact student support to recover your username.

column1: How can I check my exam results?
column2: Log in to the student portal and open the Results section.

column1: How do I change my email address?
column2: Open your account settings and update your registered email address.

column1: Where can I get technical help?
column2: Contact the IT support team for assistance with technical problems.

column1: How do I apply for a student ID?
column2: Visit the student services portal and complete the student ID application.

column1: Can I change my registered courses?
column2: Check the course registration period and contact your academic advisor if changes are needed.

column1: What happens if I miss a payment deadline?
column2: Contact the finance office to ask about late payment policies and available options.
